Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np, os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    I=np.array(G[name+' input']); O=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    h,w=I.shape
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(map(int,I[r])))==1][0]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(map(int,I[:,c])))==1][0]
    cnt=Counter(map(int,I.flatten()))
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; sep=int(I[sr][sc])
    others=[c for c in cnt if c not in (bg,sep)]
    shc=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    print('===',name,'bg',bg,'sep',sep,'shc',shc,'sr',sr,'sc',sc)
    # S cells in absolute coords
    pts=np.argwhere(I==shc)
    print('S abs:',pts.tolist())
    # output paint cells
    print('O paint cells:',np.argwhere(O==sep).tolist()[:30],'...' if len(np.argwhere(O==sep))>30 else '')

import numpy as np, os, re, itertools
from collections import Counter
Dihedral={'id':lambda S:S,'fl':lambda S:S[:,::-1],'fu':lambda S:S[::-1,:],'fb':lambda S:S[::-1,::-1]}
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
corners=[(0,0),(0,ow-1),(oh-1,0),(oh-1,ow-1)]
for n_ in range(1,9):
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n_} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n_} output'])
    H,W=I.shape; sr,sc=next(r for r in range(H) if len(set(map(int,I[r])))==1), next(c for c in range(W) if len(set(map(int,I[:,c])))==1)
    sep=int(I[sr][sc]); bgv=Counter(map(int,I.flatten())).most_common(1)[0][0]; oh,ow=O.shape
    quads={'TL':I[:sr,:sc],'TR':I[:sr,sc+1:],'BL':I[sr+1:,0:sc],'BR':I[sr+1:,sc+1:]}
    qsrc=None
    for nm,v in quads.items():
        if any(v[i,j]!=bgv for i in range(v.shape[0]) for j in range(v.shape[1])): break
        qsrc=nm
    # find src quadrant properly
    qsrc=None
    for nm,v in quads.items():
        if any(v[i,j]!=bgv for i in range(v.shape[0]) for j in range(v.shape[1])): qsrc=nm
    src=quads[qsrc]
    sm=(src!=bgv).astype(bool)
    exp=(O==sep)
    found=False
    for perm in itertools.permutations(['id','fl','fu','fb']):
        placements=[]
        ok=True
        for tm in perm:
            mt=Dihedral[tm](sm); mh,mw=mt.shape
            dr,dc=corners[perm.index(tm)]
            if not (0<=dr and dr+mh<=oh) or not (0<=dc and dc+mw<=ow): ok=False;break
            placements.append((dr,dc))
        if not ok: continue
        pred=np.zeros_like(exp)
        for (dr,dc),mt in zip(placements,[Dihedral[t](sm) for t in perm]):
            pred[dr:dr+mt.shape[0],dc:dc+mt.shape[1]]=mt
        if np.array_equal(pred,exp):
            print(n_,qsrc,'MATCH perm',perm,placements)
            found=True
    if not found: print(n_,qsrc,'no exact-cover with corners')

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
def comps(g,bg):
    lab,n=ndimage.label(np.array(g)!=bg)
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
        out.append((tuple(sorted(zip(ys,xs)))[0] if False else (min(ys),min(xs)),len(ys),tuple(sorted(zip(ys,xs)))) )
    return out
for n in range(1,9):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    bg=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci=comps(gi,bg); co=comps(go,bg)
    print(n,'in comps:',[(m,s) for m,s,_ in ci])
    print('   out comps:',[(m,s) for m,s,_ in co])
